subject: Tata Sierra

specs.name: power_petrol_na
specs.source_sentence: The 1.5-litre naturally-aspirated petrol makes 106 hp and 145 Nm, with a 6-speed manual or 7-speed dual-clutch automatic.

specs.name: power_petrol_turbo
specs.source_sentence: The 1.5-litre T-GDI Hyperion turbo-petrol makes 160 hp and 255 Nm, paired with a 6-speed torque-converter automatic.

specs.name: torque_petrol_turbo
specs.source_sentence: The 1.5 T-GDI turbo-petrol produces 255 Nm of torque.

specs.name: power_diesel
specs.source_sentence: The 1.5-litre Kryojet turbo-diesel makes 116 bhp @ 4000 rpm (about 118 PS).

specs.name: torque_diesel
specs.source_sentence: The Kryojet diesel produces 280 Nm @ 1500-2750 rpm in the automatic.

specs.name: transmission
specs.source_sentence: Gearboxes include a 6-speed manual, a 7-speed dual-clutch automatic (NA petrol) and a 6-speed torque-converter automatic (turbo-petrol and diesel).

specs.name: drivetrain
specs.source_sentence: The Tata Sierra is a front-wheel-drive monocoque SUV (no 4x4 option listed).

specs.name: adas
specs.source_sentence: Higher variants get Level 2 ADAS (13 features), with an L2+ pack adding blind-spot, ISA and rear cross-traffic alert for 22 features.

specs.name: sunroof
specs.source_sentence: The Sierra offers a voice-assisted panoramic sunroof on higher trims.

specs.name: touchscreen
specs.source_sentence: The top variant gets a 12.3-inch touchscreen (10.25-inch on mid trims).

specs.name: audio
specs.source_sentence: The Accomplished+ has 13 JBL Black speakers with SonicShaft Soundbar and Dolby Atmos (official Tata site).

specs.name: airbags
specs.source_sentence: Six airbags are standard across the range.

specs.name: boot_space
specs.source_sentence: Boot space is 622 litres, expanding to 1257 litres with the rear seat folded.

specs.name: body_type
specs.source_sentence: The Sierra is a monocoque midsize SUV (4340 mm long, 2730 mm wheelbase).

_source_note: India facts from CarDekho + ZigWheels, 2026 launch. Owner CarDekho-verifies power/price at Gate 1. Sierra is FWD (NOT 4x4) — do not imply four-wheel-drive. Turbo-petrol/diesel outputs quoted in hp at source; PS values are ~equivalent. Claimed mileage (a 29.9 kmpl figure appeared in a Q&A block) is UNVERIFIED — omitted until confirmed.
